description: This file defines the LogFileReader class in the Aws\CloudTrail namespace, which provides functionality to read and parse AWS CloudTrail log files stored in Amazon S3. It handles downloading, ungzipping, and decoding log data in JSON format.

classes.name: LogFileReader
classes.description: A class to facilitate reading, ungzipping, and parsing AWS CloudTrail log files from Amazon S3.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LogFileReader with a given S3Client instance.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Downloads, ungzips, and reads a specified CloudTrail log file from Amazon S3, returning the log records as an array.
